landmarks.description: You can enter only after defeating all 4 scarecrows and obtaining the mask.

landmarks.name: Frozen Lake Dock
landmarks.description: You cannot sail through this floating ice. Follow the edge of the ice; while facing it, look for a small cave at the far left. Sail into the cave to reach the dock.

landmarks.name: Long Pillar
landmarks.description: Location: Completing this challenge gives you one of the soul-forging items for Sanguine Reach (1/2). For the other, take the elevator down at Pangzhen Sha-Chi Tower on the left side of the map and defeat the hidden boss. With both items, you can soul-forge Sanguine Reach, adding a flame effect. Later, use Sanguine Reach to fight the Three-Faced boss to obtain the soul-forging item for Sanguine Twin and unlock the Three-Faced boss's hidden 3rd phase.

landmarks.name: Kick-Down Ladder
landmarks.description: Location: On the platforms around the house, toward the sea.

landmarks.name: Ever-Burning Lamplight - Fire Meteor Soul-Forging Material
landmarks.description: How to Obtain: As shown in the image, the Sha-Chi Tower is on the left and Fire Meteor is on the right. If you are coming out of the Sha-Chi Tower, turn left to find it.

landmarks.name: Dark-Origin Cube: Tenon
landmarks.description: How to Obtain: First defeat You Loong, the Frenzied Blackwater Crew Leader. Then clear out the Blackwater Crew's fishman enemies one by one along the shoreline. It drops only after you have defeated them all.

landmarks.name: Rouge Box
landmarks.description:
How to Obtain: After completing "Return to Your Elder Brother," speak with Master Huang at Myst's Tavern, then go to Huang Manor.

Effect:

landmarks.name: Longevity Tonic
landmarks.description:
How to Obtain: Obtained through the Bitter Kin quest. After touching Memory Flower: Bitter Kin (Part 1) earlier, you can touch Memory Flower: Bitter Kin (Part 2) here to receive Longevity Tonic.

Effect: Restores all health.

landmarks.name: Chaos Iron Fragment I
landmarks.description:
How to Obtain: Collect all 4 pieces to repair the mask (the Secrets at the Heart of the Lake side quest; defeat the hidden scarecrow boss). Find and interact with the Four Guardians' Mirror bell to enter the Phantom Illusionist Ruins. Find the Long Pillar, then defeat Master Ye to obtain it.

Collect all the fragments to combine them into Twin Chaos Irons, used to soul-forge Sanguine Twin. The other fragment is at the hidden boss in Crimson Forest.

landmarks.name: Ever-Burning Lamplight
landmarks.description: How to Obtain: Keep sailing farther in. Disembark to find the Fire Meteor soul-forging material on the shore.

landmarks.name: High-Power Water Pump
landmarks.description: How to Obtain: Defeat the boss.

landmarks.name: Searing Flame
landmarks.description:
How to Obtain: Defeat Zhu Yuan, the Searing Blade.

Use: Collect Searing Flame and Cooled Flame Grip (obtained from the 3rd Long Pillar challenge on the east side of Meigu Lake). Once you have both, find Myst in Pangzhen to soul-forge Sanguine Reach.

landmarks.name: Cooled Flame Grip
landmarks.description:
How to Obtain: Complete the Long Pillar challenge.

Use: Collect Searing Flame (from Zhu Yuan, the Searing Blade, at the base of Pangzhen Sha-Chi Tower in Meigu Lake) and Cooled Flame Grip (from the 3rd Long Pillar challenge on the east side of Meigu Lake). Once you have both, find Myst in Pangzhen to soul-forge Sanguine Reach.

landmarks.name: Old Wooden Comb
landmarks.description: How to Obtain: After obtaining the War Wagon, rest at a bonfire. There is a Memory Flower beside Old Man Gen's corpse; interact with it to obtain the comb.

landmarks.name: Blackstone Fragment
landmarks.description: How to Obtain: Open the door covered in red cloth to obtain it.

landmarks.name: Blackstone Fragment
landmarks.description: How to Obtain: Defeat the group of enemies beside the Pangzhen Sha-Chi Tower Lower Passage teleport point to receive it.

landmarks.name: Blackstone Fragment
landmarks.description: How to Obtain: After defeating the boss, look in the small house on your right. Break the crates and pots blocking the way.

landmarks.name: Sha-Chi Amber Fragment
landmarks.description: How to Obtain: Start from the White Serpent House Dock bell, turn right at the fork, then follow the outside of the house around to the back to find it.

landmarks.name: Sha-Chi Amber Fragment
landmarks.description: How to Obtain: Defeat every enemy here in the Inner Wulin.

landmarks.name: Sha-Chi Amber Fragment
landmarks.description: How to Obtain: From Zhang's teleport point, descend the ladder on the left to reach the purple chest.

landmarks.name: Sha-Chi Amber Fragment
landmarks.description: How to Obtain: Kill one Blackwater Crew angler.

landmarks.description: How to Obtain: Take the zipline near the wooden platform on Blackwater Island to the small island. Cross the walkway over the water. When you first see the blue supply pickup, turn right and collect it from the green chest.

landmarks.name: Blight-Gazing Astrolabe
landmarks.description: How to Obtain: From the bell, head out. Jumping down at the coffin advances the story; swing across on the chain to obtain the Blight-Gazing Astrolabe.

landmarks.name: Mó Yuan, Leader of the Bastion of Mó
You Loong, the Frenzied Blackwater Crew Leader
Yan Qiansui, the Zither Maiden
landmarks.description:
This boss appears only after you have collected all the Memory Flowers.

Reward: Story item - Illusory Pipa Strings.

Strategy: This fight is similar to Gu Wanyue, the Wailing Wraith. You must parry the blue orbs and the blue-glowing purple orbs to break the boss's guard before you can deal damage. Many attacks cannot be blocked, so dodge frequently.

landmarks.name: Everyone Is Welcome to Help Edit Map Markers
landmarks.description:
Because of the enormous workload, many details for later map markers are still missing. We are working overtime to finish them.
If you have tips or insights about boss locations and valuable collectibles, please help us edit the map markers to assist more users. Thank you very much for your support!
